dedupe_keys.name: plantoconnect standardised protocol for green and blue infrastructure network design in the alps interreg alpine space 2025

description: This protocol gives spatial planners a standardised method for designing networks of green and blue infrastructure that keep ecological connectivity across the Alpine region. It is deliverable D.1.4.1, version 2.2 of April 2025, of the Interreg Alpine Space project PlanToConnect, written by partners including ALPARC, the network of Alpine protected areas, the Veneto Region, the Fondazione Politecnico di Milano, Asters in Upper Savoy, the Urban Planning Institute of the Republic of Slovenia and the University of Würzburg. It describes Alpine ecological networks and their challenges and elements, a strategic framework, a design checklist for the conceptual stage and the key steps in the design process, technical methods to analyse network elements and connectivity models and tools, and monitoring with connectivity targets and measurable indicators. Coverage is the Alpine Space countries. Format and access: a free 48-page PDF. Licence: not stated. Caveats: it is guidance, with tools referenced, not supplied. It helps climate adaptation and capacity planning that treat green and blue networks as infrastructure. A related catalogue record is the green infrastructure strategy case for the Dublin city region.
